svg.title: TRINITY AI LABS · Munich
svg.desc: An eye inside a triangle of light closes and turns into a sound wave; the word TRINITY appears in braille. Most software asks you to look. We build software that listens. Build only what makes sense.

g.text: Most software asks you to look.
Die meiste Software will, dass du hinsiehst.

g.title: Time is a feature. Rewind available. (git revert)

g.text: // close your eyes. the code is still here.
